Opus 1.5.2
https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/opus/opus-1.5.2.tar.gz
SHA-256 65c1d2f78b9f2fb20082c38cbe47c951ad5839345876e46941612ee87f9a7ce1

Build recipes: scripts/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh and
scripts/build-ffmpeg-windows.sh in this application's source repository.
The binaries are separate executables invoked without shell interpolation.
Build scripts download sources only when explicitly run, and verify SHA-256
before extracting or compiling. The installed app never downloads them.

The source archives are uploaded with each future authorized application
Release. Their exact names and hashes are also pinned in manifest.json.
